clips.title: The story
paras: Vel'rin Fang needs hunters to bring tiger hides from the Echo Isles to Sen'jin Village. The Darkspear need the supplies as their numbers grow and their stores run low.

The Darkspear in Sen'jin Village have to make every resource last along Durotar's harsh coast. Tiger pelts can be made into tents, blankets and armor. As refugees arrive and scouts return, the village's stores have thinned, and leatherworker Vel'rin Fang has sent hunters out for more hides.

The Darkspear leave the tigers of Durotar largely undisturbed, hunting them only when the tribe needs more supplies. Hunters cross the water to the Echo Isles to track the predators. For the trolls, the hunt also tests patience, discipline and skill in the wild.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Many of the hides we use come from Durotar tigers, friend. Blankets, armor, tents: there are a great many reasons we hunt the beasts, and many reasons we let them thrive at the same time.
The time has come for us to cull the flock, so to speak. Our numbers grow, and our needs are beginning to overwhelm our stocks. I need more hides if I'm to prepare suitable goods for our people.
Bring me 4 Durotar tiger furs, and I shall reward you. You can find them on the islands south of here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I remember my first tiger hunt, friend. I chose to hunt on the largest of the Echo Isles, and I sat perfectly still in the shadows of its foliage for almost a full day... Watching... Waiting.
My muscles were taut, and I was ready to strike. It was one of my greatest victories when that tiger finally took the bait.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I am pleased, friend. Because of your help, our people will be protected, and not go cold as the seasons change.
